groups.G: load, update, compile, all five simulations, complete finite evidence, and connected six-wheel rover, feedback, manipulator, sample, storage, and electrical chassis paths
groups.A: path, speed, sample approach, pickup, and storage accuracy
groups.Q: body attitude, wheel slip and load-sharing proxies, bounded actuation, and chassis energy quality
groups.M: real rocker-bogie, six contacts, closed-loop actuation, physical mobile-manipulation mission, and six-drive/four-steer electrical-energy causality

groups.R: 100 percent worst-case mission performance over all required private conditions

shortcut_minimum: chassis position copied or replayed from the supplied path
one wheel signal duplicated into six apparent wheel channels

disconnected rover pose or speed feedback
terrain, path, speed, or friction input ignored
manipulator command replay without measured joint, end-effector, pickup, and storage evidence
ideal actuation or command-derived energy presented as a six-drive/four-steer electrical path
